pagedata.pyUsage: Prepare an assignment for processing by calling this routine to acquire required locks and open assignments. The caller must call this activity with a valid assignment as the primary page or provide the assignmentHandle and assignPage parameters.
pagedata.pyLabel: BPM engine API: acquire and lock work given assignment handle
pagedata.pyDescription: Given an assignment handle, opens and locks the work object and populates the flow actions
pagedata.pyDeleteMemo: BUG-138314: Do not Mrk -28 SuccessIndicator as an Error Assignment
